title: Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance - CPPB Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance - UCC: Mixed Contracts
subject: CPPB Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance

questions.q: A public agency enters a contract for a specialized computer server (cost $40,000) and installation services (cost $2,000). Under the 'predominant purpose test' used by most courts, does UCC Article 2 govern this contract?
options: No, because any inclusion of services removes it from the UCC.
Yes, because the predominant purpose of the transaction is the sale of goods.
No, because computer servers are not considered goods.
Only the $2,000 service portion is governed by the UCC.
questions.explain: For mixed contracts (goods and services), courts often use the 'predominant purpose test.' Since the vast majority of the cost and purpose is the goods (server), UCC Article 2 applies to the whole transaction.
